paraphrase: Is one to curse? Can we ward off destiny ourselves? Is one to take up anger, or give the mind over to desire?

original.text: पाबञ्जॆय् यादिरु मऩमे - नाळैक् / कोबञ्जॆय् तेयमऩ् कॊण्डोडिप् पोवाऩ् / पाबञ्जॆय् यादिरु मऩमे। / साबम् कॊडुत्तिड लामो ? - विदि / तऩ्ऩै नम्माले तडुत्तिडलामो ? / कोबऩ् तॊडुत्तिडलामो ? - इच्चै / कॊळ्ळक् करुत्तैक् कॊडुत्तिडलामो ?
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: Climb the path of true knowledge; become clear about the open space of pure Vedānta; reproach the way of ignorance; tell those who come to you the way to bliss.

original.text: मॆञ्ञाऩप् पादैयि लेऱु - सुत्त / वेदान्द वॆट्ट वॆळियिऩैत् तेऱु / अञ्ञाऩ मार्क्कत्तैत् तूऱु - उऩ्ऩै / अण्डिऩोर्क् काऩन्द मांवऴि कूऱु।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: Nothing comes with you; carrying this worm-body about is only trouble; the release that is sought has no limit, yet no one is clear about the way to seek it.

original.text: कूडवरुव तॊऩ्ऱिल्लै - पुऴुक् / कूडॆडुत् तिङ्ङऩ् उलैवदे तॊल्लै / तेडरु मोट्चम तॆल्लै - अदैत् / तेडुम् वऴियैत् तॆळिवोरु मिल्लै।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: A forest that five surround; a land where the five meet their five; search for it before it is too late: to know that root is the house of liberation.

original.text: ऐन्दुबेर् सूऴ्न्दिडुङ् गाडु - इन्द / ऐवर्क्कुम् ऐवर् अडैन्दिडुम् नाडु / मुन्दि वरुन्दिऩी तेडु - अन्द / मूलम् अऱिन्दिड वामुत्ति वीडु।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: Within is a fourfold fort; seize it so the enemy flees and you can rule the land; cut down the forest called the thieving senses and burn it — then you can see the house (of release).

original.text: उळ्ळाग नाल्वगैक् कोट्टै - पगै / ओडप् पिडित्तिट्टाल् आळलाम् नाट्टै / कळ्ळप् पुलऩॆऩ्ऩुङ् गाट्टै - वॆट्टिक् / कऩलिट् टॆरित्तिट्टाऱ् काणलाम् वीट्टै।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse. The 'fourfold fort' is naturally read as the four inner faculties (antakkaraṇam); the verse does not name them.

paraphrase: Will karma go by going to Kāśī? Is there salvation in bathing in the Gaṅgā? Will the karma you speak of die? Will the many differences of birth go even by praising?

original.text: कासिक्को टिल्विऩै पोमो - अन्दक् / कङ्गैया टिल्गदि ताऩुमुण् डामो ? / पेसुमुऩ् कऩ्मङ्गळ् सामो ? - पल / पेदम् पिऱप्पदु पोऱ्ऱिऩुम् पोमो।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: Devotion is the highest thing on earth; to those who hold it comes liberation; the powers (citti) that exalt in glory come to anyone only through Śiva's working — the line closes on the word 'devotion' (patti).

original.text: पारि लुयर्न्ददु पक्ति - अदैप् / पऱ्ऱिऩ पेर्क्कुण्डु मेवरु मुत्ति / सीरि लुयरट्ट सित्ति - यार्क्कुञ् / जित्तिक्कु मेसिवऩ् सॆयलिऩाल् पत्ति।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: The play is played by the soul; when the soul leaves the body, the body withers.

original.text: आऩ्मावाल् आडिडु माट्टम् - तेगत् / ताऩ्मा अऱ्ऱबोदे यामुडल् वाट्टम् / वाऩ्गदि मीदिले नाट्टम् - नाळुम् / वैयिलुऩक्कु वरुमे कॊण्डाट्टम्।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: Do not revile even those who revile you; though the whole world lies, do not lie; do no cruel deeds; do not throw stones at the birds.

original.text: वैदोरैक् कूडवै यादे: - इन्द / वैयम् मुऴुदुम् पॊय्त्तालुम् पॊय्यादे / वॆय्य विऩैगळ् सॆय्यादे - कल्लै / वीणिऱ् पऱवैगळ् मीदि लॆय्यादे।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: Want nothing but Śiva; do not stir up harmful quarrels; do not abandon the state of tapas; do not seek books that lack the true path (caṉmārkkam).

original.text: सिवमऩ्ऱि वेऱे वेण्डादे - यार्क्कुऩ् / तीङ्गाऩ सण्डैयैच् चिऱक्कत् तूण्डादे / तवऩिलै विट्टुत् ताण्डादे - नल्ल / सऩ्मार्क्क मिल्लाद नूलै वेण्डादे।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: Do not smoke ganja; do not drink the toddy that shows intoxication and stupor; do not kill a frightened life; do not read the books of ignorance that lack devotion.

original.text: कञ्जाप् पुगैबिडि यादे - वॆऱि / काट्टि मयङ्गिय कट्कुडि यादे! / अञ्ज वुयिर् मडियादे - पत्ति / अऱ्ऱवञ् ञाऩत्तिऩ् नूल्बडि यादे।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: This body is a bubble on water; it will not stay but pass — know this. Devise a way to live with no attachment at all to the love of the world.

original.text: नीर्मेऱ् कुमिऴियिक् कायम् - इदु / निल्लादु पोय्विडुम् नीयऱिमायम् / पार्मीदिल् मॆत्तवुम् नेयम् - सऱ्ऱुम् / पऱ्ऱा तिरुन्दिडप्पण्णु मुबायम्।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: Set up the ladder called devotion, stretch it to the place free of bonds, lay on it what is called truth, and make it daily your own, driving off the sects.

original.text: पत्ति यॆऩुमेणि नाट्टित् - तॊन्द / पन्दमऱ्ऱ विडम् पार्त्तदै नीट्टिच् / चत्तिय मॆऩ्ऱदै यीट्टि - नाळुम् / तऩ्वस माक्किक्कॊळ् समयङ्ग ळोट्टि।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse. 'camayaṅkaḷ ōṭṭi' (driving off the sects/creeds) is rendered literally.

paraphrase: Spurn all the untold delusions and hold to firm discernment; know well the peerless eight-limbed yoga and its true union.

original.text: सॆप्परुम् पलविद मोगम् - ऎल्लाम् / सीयॆऩ् ऱॊऱुत्तुत् तिडङ्गॊळ् विवेगम् / ऒप्परुम् अट्टाङ्ग योगम् - नऩ्ऱाय् / ओर्न्दऱि वायवऱ् ऱुण्मैसम् पोगम्।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: Whatever the conduct, know it all and teach it; the many castes that are called unequal — know them as one and realize it.

original.text: ऎव्वगै यागऩऩ् नीदि - अवै / ऎल्ला मऱिन्दे यॆडुत्तु नीबोदि / ऒव्वा वॆऩ्ऱ पलसादि - यावुम् / ऒऩ्ऱॆऩ् ऱऱिन्दे युणर्न्दुऱ वोदि।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: Do not put on a false garb; do not soak your duty in many Gaṅgās; do not think of plunder; do not rush into quarrels with friends.

original.text: कळ्ळ वेडम् पुऩैयादे - पल / कङ्गैयि लेयुऩ् कडऩ् नऩैयादे / कॊळ्ळै कॊळ्ळ निऩैयादे - नट्पु / कॊण्डु पुरिन्दुऩी कोळ् मुऩैयादे।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: The Lord (Īcaṉ) is self-luminous everywhere; he dwells in the joyful heart of those who love him; he is the servant of his lofty devotees; to those who praise him he grants the (highest) state.

original.text: ऎङ्गुम् सुयबिर कासऩ् - अऩ्बर् / इऩ्ब इरुदयत् तिरुन्दिडुम् वासऩ् / तुङ्ग अडियवर् तासऩ् - तऩ्ऩैत् / तुदुक्किऱ् पदवि अरुळुवाऩ् ईसऩ्।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: In a flower-garden a mendicant, after begging the potter for four and six months, got a pot; dancing and dancing, he dropped it and broke it.

original.text: नन्द वऩत्तिलो राण्डि - अवऩ् / नालाऱु मादमाय्क् कुयवऩै वेण्डिक् / कॊण्डुवऩ् ताऩॊरु तोण्डि - मॆत्तक् / कूत्ताडिक् कूत्ताडिप् पोट्टुडैत्ताण्डि।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse. The later tradition reads the pot as the hard-won human body wasted in play (interpretation, not in the verse).

paraphrase: Do not speak slander; not a speck of the wealth you pile up will stay; the three desires are evil; if you set your desire on Śiva, Yama's world will not be evil for you.

original.text: तूडण मागच्चॊल् लादे - तेडुञ् / जॊत्तुगळिलॊरु तूसुम् निल्लादे / एडाणै मूऩ्ऱुम् पॊल्लादे - सिवत् / तिच्चैवैत् तालॆम लोगम् पॊल्लादे।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: Seek the good path; seek the Supreme every day; join the company of the able; praise that Bountiful One in the heart and celebrate.

original.text: नल्ल वऴिदऩै नाडु- ऎन्द / नाळुम् परमऩै नत्तिये तेडु / वल्लवर् कूट्टत्तिऱ् कूडु - अन्द / वळ्ळलै नॆञ्जिऩिल् वाऴ्त्तिक् कॊण्डाडु।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse.

paraphrase: Stand by the rule of the Veda; go the way the good follow; speak of the settled state; subdue that low, outcaste (caṇṭāḷa) anger.

original.text: वेद विदिप्पडि निल्लु - नल्लोर् / मेवुम् वऴियिऩै वेण्डिये सॆल्लु / साद निलैमैये सॊल्लु - पॊल्लाच् / चण्डाळक् कोबत्तैच् चादित्तुक् कॊल्लु।
original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
original.licence: Project Madurai: free distribution with header intact

speaker: Kaṭuveḷic cittar
notes: Ref and wording checked in the local e-text; paraphrase by U22 from the verse. Recorded faithfully: this Siddhar enjoins the Veda's rule and uses 'caṇṭāḷa' as a term of abuse for anger.

paraphrase: Do no sin, O mind: tomorrow Yama, in anger, will carry you off.

original.edition: Cittar pāṭalkaḷ tokuppu I (Project Madurai 1999; GRETIL Devanāgarī transliteration)
